question: What authoritative embodiment is ascribed to Shri Tripura in this praise?
premises: The speaker explicitly praises Shri Tripura.
She is described as being the sheath of the four commands.
This epithet presents her as embodying authoritative power.
inference: Shri Tripura is praised as the embodiment and repository of the four commands.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal meaning of the four commands in this context is not explicit.
plain_english: I praise Shri Tripura, who embodies the sheath of the four commands.
